title: #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: Black people were learning just fine
prior to 1954. They did not desegregate
public schools so black children could
get a better education. They
desegregated black schools because they
were concerned about the growth of black
excellence. Keep in mind, we invented
the gas mask before we went to school
with white children. We invented the
stoplight before we went to school with
white children. We invented the
refrigerated truck before we went to
school with white children. They did not
desegregate to help us. They
desegregated to hinder us. They saw
Black Wall Street in Tulsa. They saw
Black Wall Street in Rosewood. They saw
Black Wall Street in Wilmington, North
Carolina. They saw Black Wall Street in
Charleston. They saw independent black
communities even here in Ohio. And they
decided that if we want to stop the
progress of black people, we must take
over control of their children's
education. And when they desegregated
the schools, they did not bring black
teachers with black students. The
biggest layoff in public education is
between 1954 and 1974 of black teachers.
They brought our children into the
schools. They fired the teachers.
